_comment: The data files of dist/ that a page loads only with the figures that use them: read by geores.lua (which files a page loads) and tools/build.mjs (dist/catalog.json). A bundle is loaded when the sim or diagram is in `names`, when the diagram is in `diagrams` (a static map that needs more than the sim of the same name), and, with `when`, only if the shortcode has these options. `images`: large pictures used by one sim only (dist/<image>.js points GeoRes.images at the picture next to it). Every page with a figure also loads dist/world.js and dist/geores.js.

textures.about: Earth texture for the textured globe (about 0.6 MB)

climate.about: climate stations, the 1° Köppen grids and the climate series (about 1 MB)

climate-wmo.about: every station of the WMO normals 1991-2020, 4 693 stations (about 0.8 MB)

climate-europe.about: the 0.1° Köppen classes of Europe (about 0.7 MB)

climate-russia.about: the 0.1° Köppen classes of Russia (about 0.9 MB)

history.about: historical borders of Russia, the Golden Horde and Europe (about 0.4 MB)

countries.about: countries of the world, Natural Earth 1:50m (about 0.5 MB)

geopolitics.about: disputed areas and points of view, border walls, chokepoints, Arctic sea ice, armed conflicts

sea.about: sea zones and land of the Eastern Mediterranean (about 560 kB)

urban.about: cities, towns and rural areas 1950-2050, cities 1975-2050, urban networks (about 360 kB)

votes.about: a Swiss vote by commune (about 400 kB)

russia.about: population of Russia: vital statistics, pyramids, regions (about 360 kB)

tectonics.about: plates, earthquakes, volcanoes, age of the ocean floor (about 0.6 MB)

paleo.about: coasts of the past, 0-250 Ma (about 1.2 MB)
